actions.name: sneeze_cough
actions.text: a person brings a hand to the mouth while the head jerks forward
paraphrases: a person covers the mouth with one hand and bends the head down sharply
a person lifts a hand to the face as the upper body jolts forward
a person jerks the head and shoulders forward with a hand at the mouth
actions.motion: The right hand or both hands rise quickly to the front of the mouth, with the elbow bent in front of the chest. The head and upper torso jerk forward and down in one or several short sudden movements. The hand stays near the mouth during the jerks, then the body straightens and the hand lowers.

phases.middle: sudden forward jerk of head and torso, may repeat

confusable_with.name: yawn
confusable_with.visible_difference: yawn moves the hand to the mouth slowly with the head tilting back, not jerking forward

confusable_with.name: blow_nose
confusable_with.visible_difference: blow_nose holds both hands steady at the nose without a body jerk

confusable_with.name: nausea_vomiting
confusable_with.visible_difference: vomiting bends the torso much further forward and holds there

actions.name: staggering
actions.text: a person walks unsteadily with the body swaying from side to side
paraphrases: a person takes uneven steps while the torso tilts left and right
a person moves forward with irregular steps and an unbalanced swaying body
a person stumbles along with arms out and the upper body wobbling
actions.motion: The person takes several uneven steps, with the feet landing at irregular spacing and sometimes crossing. The torso and head sway from side to side and forward and back, and the hip shifts with each step. The arms may move out from the body to keep balance. The whole body travels a short distance in a wavering path.

phases.middle: irregular steps with side-to-side torso lean
phases.end: body slows and regains balance or stops

not_observable: dizziness or intoxication as the cause

confusable_with.name: falling_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: falling_down ends with the body low on the floor

confusable_with.name: walking_towards
confusable_with.visible_difference: walking_towards has steady straight steps and a second person

confusable_with.name: hopping
confusable_with.visible_difference: hopping lifts the body off the ground on one leg repeatedly

actions.name: falling_down
actions.text: a person drops from standing to the floor, ending low on the ground
paraphrases: a person collapses downward with the hips and torso sinking to the floor
a person loses balance and goes down until the body is near the ground
a person sinks from an upright posture to sitting or lying on the floor
actions.motion: From standing, the knees bend and the hip moves rapidly downward, often with the torso tilting forward or sideways. The hands may reach toward the floor to break the fall. The body ends with the hip and torso very low, on the knees, sitting, or lying, and stays down. The movement happens once and is faster than sitting down.

phases.middle: rapid downward drop of hip and torso

confusable_with.name: sit_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: sit_down lowers the hip slowly and ends at chair height

confusable_with.name: squat_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: squatting keeps the torso upright and the feet planted

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: pick_up bends briefly and returns to standing

actions.name: headache
actions.text: a person holds one or both hands against the head with head tilted
paraphrases: a person presses a hand on the forehead and lowers the head slightly
a person raises the hands to the sides of the head and holds them
a person keeps a hand on the head while the head bends forward
actions.motion: One or both hands rise to the forehead or temples, with the elbows bent and raised. The hands stay on the head for a long time, sometimes with small rubbing movements. The head tilts forward or to the side and the shoulders may hunch. The hands then lower.

phases.middle: hands held on forehead or temples, head tilted

confusable_with.name: neck_pain
confusable_with.visible_difference: neck_pain places the hand on the back of the neck, lower than the head

confusable_with.name: wipe_face
confusable_with.visible_difference: wipe_face strokes the hands across the face rather than holding

confusable_with.name: salute
confusable_with.visible_difference: salute holds the elbow out sideways with the head upright

actions.name: chest_pain
actions.text: a person presses a hand on the chest and leans forward slightly
paraphrases: a person holds one hand flat against the chest with the shoulders hunched
a person clutches the chest with a hand and bends the upper body
a person places both hands on the chest and curls the torso forward
actions.motion: The right hand, sometimes both hands, moves to the center or left of the chest and stays pressed there. The torso bends forward a little and the shoulders round inward, and the head may drop. The posture is held for a while, sometimes with a slight stagger. The hands then lower and the body straightens.

phases.middle: hand held on chest, torso bent forward

confusable_with.name: nausea_vomiting
confusable_with.visible_difference: vomiting places the hand on the stomach or mouth and bends further

confusable_with.name: cross_arms
confusable_with.visible_difference: cross_arms folds both arms across the chest with an upright torso

confusable_with.name: back_pain
confusable_with.visible_difference: back_pain puts the hand behind the body on the lower back

actions.name: back_pain
actions.text: a person places a hand on the lower back and arches backward
paraphrases: a person reaches one hand behind to the lower back and holds it
a person puts both hands on the back of the waist and leans
a person holds the lower back with a hand behind the body
actions.motion: The right hand, often both, moves behind the body to rest on the lower back near the hips, with the elbows pointing backward and out. The torso leans back or bends slightly forward and may twist. The hands stay on the back for a while. Then the hands come forward and lower.

phases.middle: hands held on lower back, torso arched or bent

confusable_with.name: reach_into_pocket
confusable_with.visible_difference: pocket reach goes to the side or back of the hip briefly and returns

confusable_with.name: stretch_oneself
confusable_with.visible_difference: stretching raises the arms high overhead

confusable_with.name: chest_pain
confusable_with.visible_difference: chest_pain puts the hand on the front of the chest

actions.name: neck_pain
actions.text: a person holds a hand on the back of the neck, tilting head
paraphrases: a person raises one hand behind the neck and keeps it there
a person rubs the back of the neck with one hand and bends the head
a person lifts a hand to the neck and rolls the head slightly
actions.motion: The right hand rises and reaches behind the head to the back of the neck, with the elbow bent and pointing forward or up. The hand stays there, sometimes making small rubbing motions. The head tilts forward, back, or to the side, and may rotate slowly. The hand then lowers.

phases.middle: hand on back of neck, head tilting

confusable_with.name: headache
confusable_with.visible_difference: headache puts the hand on the forehead or temples in front

confusable_with.name: brush_hair
confusable_with.visible_difference: brush_hair moves the hand in repeated long strokes over the head

confusable_with.name: flick_hair
confusable_with.visible_difference: flick_hair is a quick single sweep past the side of the head

actions.name: nausea_vomiting
actions.text: a person bends forward at the waist with a hand at mouth or stomach
paraphrases: a person leans the torso far forward and holds a hand at the mouth
a person doubles over with a hand on the belly and head lowered
a person hunches forward and down with the head dropped toward the floor
actions.motion: The torso bends forward from the hips and the head drops down and forward. One hand moves to the mouth or the stomach, and the other may rest on the knee or hang down. The upper body may jerk forward a few times while bent. The bent posture is held for a while before the person straightens.

phases.start: hand moves to mouth or stomach
phases.middle: torso bent far forward, head low, possible jerks

confusable_with.name: sneeze_cough
confusable_with.visible_difference: sneeze_cough has a shorter, shallower forward jerk and quick return

confusable_with.name: nod_head_bow
confusable_with.visible_difference: a bow bends forward with arms at sides and returns quickly

confusable_with.name: chest_pain
confusable_with.visible_difference: chest_pain keeps the hand on the chest with only a slight lean

actions.name: fan_self
actions.text: a person waves one hand back and forth in front of the face
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand repeatedly near the face in short swings
a person flaps one hand toward the face several times in a row
a person holds a hand in front of the face and swings it quickly
actions.motion: The right hand rises to in front of the face or neck, with the elbow bent in front of the chest. The hand and forearm swing quickly back and forth toward and away from the face, many times, with the motion mostly at the wrist and elbow. The torso and head stay still. The hand then lowers.

phases.start: hand rises in front of face
phases.middle: rapid repeated small swings toward the face

confusable_with.name: hand_waving
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand_waving raises the hand higher, away from the face, and swings side to side

confusable_with.name: wipe_face
confusable_with.visible_difference: wipe_face makes contact and strokes over the face

confusable_with.name: brush_teeth
confusable_with.visible_difference: brush_teeth keeps the hand at the mouth with small side-to-side motion

actions.name: punch_slap
actions.text: a person swings an arm to strike another person's head or upper body
paraphrases: a person thrusts a fist toward another person's face, who flinches back
a person hits another person with a fast swing of the right arm
two people stand close as one swings a hand quickly at the other's head
actions.motion: The actor stands facing the partner and draws the right arm back, then swings or thrusts it quickly forward so the hand reaches the partner's head or chest. The actor's torso may rotate and lean into the strike. The partner's head and upper body jerk back or turn away at the moment of contact, and the partner may raise an arm to protect. The actor's arm then pulls back.

phases.start: two people face each other, actor draws arm back
phases.middle: fast arm swing reaches partner's head, partner recoils

confusable_with.name: pushing
confusable_with.visible_difference: pushing uses both hands on the chest and moves the partner backward

confusable_with.name: hit_with_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: hit_with_object uses a larger overhead swing

confusable_with.name: pat_on_back
confusable_with.visible_difference: pat_on_back has slow repeated gentle contact on the partner's back
